name: Forte — MIPS16e for Binary Ninja
description: MIPS16e disassembly, mixed-mode ELF routing, and LLIL for Binary Ninja, powered by pypcode.
longdescription: Forte adds big- and little-endian MIPS16e support to Binary Ninja. It recognizes the low-bit mode tag used by mixed MIPS32/MIPS16 ELF symbols, decodes 16- and 32-bit compressed instructions, models delay slots without duplicating their side effects, supplies Linux o32 calling conventions, and lifts common SLEIGH p-code operations into Binary Ninja LLIL. Built-in commands seed existing databases, run a decoder self-test, and report LLIL coverage. Forte runs inside Binary Ninja and does not invoke Ghidra or an external disassembler.

installinstructions.Darwin: Install through Binary Ninja's Plugin Manager, or clone the repository into ~/Library/Application Support/Binary Ninja/plugins/forte-binja. Binary Ninja installs pypcode from requirements.txt.
installinstructions.Linux: Install through Binary Ninja's Plugin Manager, or clone the repository into ~/.binaryninja/plugins/forte-binja. Binary Ninja installs pypcode from requirements.txt.
installinstructions.Windows: Install through Binary Ninja's Plugin Manager, or clone the repository into %APPDATA%\Binary Ninja\plugins\forte-binja. Binary Ninja installs pypcode from requirements.txt.
